text:
zoe: Follow-up from the postmortem — we keep seeing short overnight model-load failures (~2-4m) that surface as 503 bursts. Proposal: ship a tiny micro-playbook + a "triage-kit" script and a cron warmup. two-week goal.

zoe: Proposed owners (compact):
- Micro-playbook (one-page, exact commands + escalation ladder 0/1/5m): owner: rafael. due: 2024-12-12
- triage-kit (single executable script: health, p50/p95, error-rate, quick logs): owner: nina. due: 2024-12-12
- cron warmup (k8s CronJob at 23:45): owner: lior. due: 2024-12-10
- fallback routing (partial traffic to standby variant on spike): owner: zoe. due: 2024-12-18

zoe: triage-kit sketch (one-liners for on-call, do NOT hardcode tokens):
curl -fsS https://api.redwood-infer/health || echo "health:FAIL"
curl -sS "https://metrics/api?query=model_load_latency_p50" -H "Authorization: Bearer $METRICS_KEY" | jq .
curl -sS "https://metrics/api?query=request_error_rate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $METRICS_KEY" | jq .
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=runtime --tail=200 | sed -n '1,200p'

nina: i'll take triage-kit. script will read METRICS_KEY from env or prompt, support --quick and --full, and have --dry-run. won't log secrets.

rafael: taking the micro-playbook. top-of-doc: 5-step checklist (detect, confirm, collect, switch, escalate). escalation ladder: 0m post to incident channel, 1m page on-call, 5m escalate to platform lead. include contact vault link.

lior: i'll own the CronJob PR. will schedule warmups at 23:45 and 02:15 and add a graceful backoff. will tag infra if needed.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2024-799 created and linked. Tabletop rehearsal set for 2024-12-07 17:00 UTC.

zoe: please reference epic RINF-799 in PRs. i'll hold playbook review until triage-kit and cronjob PRs are linked. after PRs land we'll run a quick tabletop to validate ergonomics. keep playbook language prescriptive and minimal top-level steps.

nina: posting a first-pass gist of triage-kit by EOD tomorrow.

rafael: will open playbook PR Monday.

lior: aiming for cronjob PR this week.

zoe: thanks all. prioritize the on-call one-click path first; append SRE diagnostics in an appendix.

nina: :thumbsup:

rafael: :white_check_mark:
